watches.name: Maple Red
watches.description: Our straps are meticulously handcrafted by a family-run atelier in Belgium specialising in beautiful, premium watch straps. Material Handcrafted from Alcantara (a cutting-edge material developed in Italy) that offers unrivalled aesthetic, technical and tactile qualities. Whilst similar to suede, it is far more hard-wearing (and crucially, is water-resistant) and whilst commonly found in the interior of luxury sports cars it offers excellent properties as a watch strap. Colour A cosy, warm colour, reminiscent of leaves falling from a maple tree and evokes a real feeling of Autumnal change. Surface Finish Alcantara is extremely soft to touch and provides a luxurious feel - it has a similar feel to the nap of suede but is considerably harder-wearing with a supple feel. Lining Lined in a premium anti-allergenic calf leather and embossed with both our logo and ‘Handmade in Belgium’ - this is both soft and comfortable and will extend the lifetime of your strap. Buckle Please note; the image shows our legacy buckle whereas this strap is now finished with Fears' new bespoke pin buckle (featuring the Fears Cypher). Size Designed to fit all Fears Redcliff, Brunswick and Archival watches, this strap will also fit any watch with a 20mm lug width . The strap is available in two sizes: Standard fits wrists measuring 178 - 210mm (approx.) Shorter fits wrists measuring 164 - 197mm (approx.) Fit yourself Featuring Quick-Release spring bars , our straps can be fitted and removed from the watch using no tools. This means you can change it over in a matter of moments with no hassle.

watches.name: Redcliff 39.5 Date 'Facebook Edition'
watches.description: Fears in collaboration with Meta Hand built in England. Please note: this order window has now closed - if you have any further queries or missed the opportunity to order please email enquiries@fearswatches.com As Fears celebrates its 180th and 10th anniversaries simultaneously, the Redcliff model made for the perfect choice as not only was this the silhouette (in a quartz configuration) that the brand was re-launched with in 2016 it also takes it's name from the district of Bristol where the company was first founded in 1846. Case : 39.5mm, 316L stainless steel, brushed and polished , 20mm lug width Dial : Social Blue, painted gradient, white and blue printing Strap : Blue , Alcantara®, handmade Bracelet : 3-link, stainless steel bracelet with screw links and fold-over clasp with micro-adjust Movement : LJP G100, time and date, automatic, 68hr power reserve Water Resistance : 150 metres (15 ATM) CASE The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'Facebook Edition' is housed in a contemporary round case with integrated lugs alongside a screw-down case back, bezel and crown. Spanning 39.5mm in diameter yet with a case thickness of only 9.98mm, this slim case combines a brushed middle-section with the polished finish of the bezel's graceful profile. The proportions of the case and its integrated lugs help ensure the watch will perfectly fit the contours of any wrist. These special editions of the Redcliff in collaboration with Meta are the only releases (outside of the '1846 Edition' we've made for British Watchmakers' Day) to feature the Fears 180 logo (which can be found engraved on the rear side of one of the lugs). CASEBACK The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'Facebook Edition' comes with an open exhibition caseback that offers an unobstructed view of our finely decorated movement (and customised Fears-branded rotor) - the first time a Meta collaboration has featured an open caseback. DIAL The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'Facebook Edition' features a multi-level dial with a gradated blue central dial (using the primary Facebook Pantone references) with a white painted outer minute track. The baton indexes are crafted from a block of brass before being diamond polished and coated in precious rhodium. The 12 o'clock index on our regular Redcliff Collection features a subtle reference to our heritage (the shape and form of the towers that hoist Bristol's world famous Clifton Suspension Bridge) whereas on the 'Meta Collection' they reference another iconic symbol - the app icon. At 3 o’clock a date window is cut into the dial revealing a colour-matched date disc featuring numerals in our own bespoke ‘Edwin’ typeset. The window itself features a shallow bevel running around all four sides to aid legibility whilst reading the date and gives the optical illusion of it appearing larger. The indices have been hand-filled with Grade A Super-LumiNova before being carefully hand-applied to the dial. HANDS The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'Facebook Edition' has distinctive ‘ Fears ’-shaped hands that are tri-bevelled and diamond polished before in this example being finished in a coating of precious rhodium (thus matching the indices). During the day the tri-bevelled edges will catch the light brilliantly, allowing the time to be read easily. Whilst in low-light conditions, the bright Grade A lume glows with a strong blue-green colour. MOVEMENT The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'Facebook Edition' is powered by a customised Swiss-made, automatic La Joux-Perret G100 movement. Winding itself when worn on the wrist, this movement features a quick-set date, a generous power reserve of 68 hours and a decorated winding rotor. BRACELET & STRAP The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'Facebook Edition' comes with both our bespoke 3-link stainless steel bracelet and an additional Alcantara ® strap. Bracelet Featuring solid screw links, the bracelet combines brushed and polished elements and has a substantial feel while the silky-smooth movement of the links ensure a comfortable fit around the wrist. watches.name: Arnos Opera Black
watches.description: The rectangular Fears Hand-built in Britain in small batches. The Fears Arnos Collection continues the tradition of naming our core watch families after locations in Bristol with historic relevance to Fears. Arnos Vale is the area where the Fears headquarters are located today, but also the home to the cemetery where both our original founder (Edwin Fear) and his son and successor (Amos Daniel Fear) happen to be buried. The Fears Arnos Opera Black joins the Pewter Blue in this important collection that focuses on contemporary watches with an angular case shape. The Fears Archive is well stocked with elegant rectangular watches, all with this distinctive tall and thin silhouette. Case: Curved 22.6 x 40mm (end of lugs), stainless steel, brushed and polished, 20mm lug width Dial: Opera Black colour, black onyx and white lacquer Strap: Comes with two black straps: Epsom calf leather & Grosgrain silk, both hand-made Movement: Sellita SW1000-1b, time only, automatic Water Resistance: 30 metres (3 ATM) CASE The Arnos ' slim and elegant rectangular case takes inspiration from the rectangular watches in the Fears Archive dating from the 1920s and 30s. The Arnos case is expertly machined from 316L Stainless Steel, in Switzerland, to a level usually reserved for precious metals. This precisely milled case has then been finished with a combination of linearly brushed and highly polished surfaces. This tall, slim watch is supremely comfortable due to its elegantly curved profile - the crystal, case and caseback all possess the same matching curvature that maps the contours of the wrist perfectly. Complementing the case is a new bespoke (subtly onion-shaped, yet contemporary) winding crown, signed with the Fears Cypher. DIAL Expertly made in Germany, the Arnos Opera Black dial continues the design ethos of this range with a circle set within a rectangular that in this example exudes a monochromatic elegance. Outer Dial – a segment of polished black onyx Inner Dial – a crisp white lacquer The otherwise negative space is filled with a set of thin protruding roman numerals that emanate from the centre to perfectly fill the expanse of the outer dial. HANDS The Arnos uses solid ‘Fears pipette’ shaped hands that feature a central diamond-cut bevel down each edge and the tip, before being coated in a Black Gold plating. The expertly three-way mirror polished surfaces will catch the light brilliantly and thus enhance legibility. MOVEMENT The Arnos is powered by a top-grade Swiss-made, automatic Sellita SW1000 movement (that has been customised for Fears to display just hours / minutes). Winding itself when worn on the wrist, this small but mighty movement offers a power reserve of 46 hours and features a Fears Blue decorated rotor (which as per Fears tradition, also features the flower of Bristol motif). STRAPS Each Arnos Opera Black comes complete with two equally elegant straps that have been specially chosen for this model. Epsom Leather The Arnos Opera Black is fitted with a hand-made Obsidian Black strap crafted from Epsom leather for everyday wear. The premium leather used for this strap is prized for it's unique texture and durability, and is widely used by luxury houses for their small leather goods. The pebbled pattern embossed on the top side gives the leather a distinctive look and the complex tanning process it will had undergone prior increases it's resistance against scratches and scuffs. Lined in genuine Alcantara® dyed a deep shade of blue, this lining is supremely soft against the skin yet resistant against wear. This strap is finished with Fears' bespoke pin buckle (featuring the Fears Cypher). Grosgrain Silk For when you may be required to don your finest dress, the second strap is the perfect accoutrement - crafted from the finest Grosgrain silk this strap brings a clean and tailored look to already elegant ensemble. watches.name: Brunswick 39 Perpetual Calendar
watches.description: The complicated Fears Please note : the Brunswick 39 Perpetual Calendar is a limited-production model with a maximum of 25 pieces made per year and the 2026 allocation has now sold-out. We are now taking pre-orders for the 2027 allocation that will begin shipping from May 2027 . Hand-built in Britain. The Brunswick 39 Perpetual Calendar is the most complicated watch Fears has ever made . A watch that displays the full calendar, which is adjusted automatically (despite the length of month) whilst also taking into account the leap year every four years (with no interaction required from the owner). As the first automatic perpetual calendar wrist watch from a British brand in modern times, this is the pinnacle of Fears. Case : 39mm, stainless steel, brushed & polished, 20mm lug width Dial : Silver Mink , lightly frosted, coated in pure silver, black and cyan printing Strap: Walnut , matte Ostrich (with matching brushed & polished Fears buckle) Movement: Dubois Depraz 55115, time, day, date, month, leap-year, moonphase (adjusting perpetually until the year 2100), automatic (solid 18ct gold rotor), 47hr power reserve Water Resistance: 50 metres (5 ATM) Graceful and complex, the Brunswick 39 Perpetual Calendar introduces a new case architecture to the Brunswick family with flat brushed sides, polished wide bevels and a concave bezel and caseback. The silhouette takes its inspiration from a gentleman’s cushion case watch in the Fears archives, first made in 1924 and seen here in its most multifaceted, yet elegant execution. CASE The Brunswick 39 Perpetual Calendar introduces a new complex case to the Brunswick family. At just 9.4mm thin with an additional 0.7mm of domed sapphire crystal, this is the slimmest Brunswick made to date. The case is machined from a solid block of 316L stainless steel in Switzerland where it has undergone careful finishing with brushed and highly polished surfaces, which highlight its glancing curves. The bezel and caseback both feature a concave profile which is a first for a Fears watch. This profile lends a sophisticated feel to the watch, while also visually slimming the watch even further so its sits low down on the wrist. Complementing the case is the Fears bespoke ‘onion’-shaped winding crown that has been signed with the Fears Cypher. Across the case band are four discreet 'corrector' pushers. Each one, when depressed, adjusts one of the many functions of the watch (which once set will not need to be adjusted again until the year 2100). 50m (5 ATM) of water resistance allows the Brunswick 39 Perpetual Calendar to be worn and enjoyed everyday taking splashes and light submersion in its stride. Caseback The Brunswick 39 Perpetual Calendar is offered exclusively with an open exhibition caseback, offering an unobstructed view of the finely hand-decorated movement and its solid 18ct gold rotor adorned with the Bristol flower and polished cypher emblem. DIAL The Silver Mink dial on the Brunswick 39 Perpetual Calendar has a warm, yet bright, silver appearance with a refined lightly-frosted surface finish making it legible whilst not distracting. With this watch being a perpetual calendar there is a significant amount of information conveyed on its dial. Each calendar indications resides in their own sub-dial with fine grooves cut into the sunken surface and a bespoke set of 'Bristol' letters & numerals created by Fears' in-house designer exclusively for this watch. Crisp black printing creates a pleasing contrast with the soft silver base colour ensuring the time (along with the day, date, month and leap-year) can all be read at a moments glance. The hand-applied indicies are milled from a block of brass before being diamond cut and polished with each one receiving four bevels that catch the light with a sparkle. watches.name: Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Ultimus'
watches.description: The final Jump Hour All orders of the final jump hour will begin shipping from November 2026 Case : 40.5mm, stainless steel, brushed and polished, 20mm lug width Dial : Phantom White, sapphire with luminous ceramic centre Strap : Obsidian Black, Epsom leather, handmade Bracelet: 5-link, stainless steel bracelet with screw links and butterfly clasp Movement : Christopher Ward's JJ01 Module, Sellita SW200 base Water Resistance : 100 metres (10 ATM) The Fears Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Ultimus' (created in collaboration with Andrew Morgan ) unveils the most contemporary but also the final edition of the Jump Hour. The 1920s was the origin of the first Fears' wristwatches and this iconic Art Deco period also formed the inspiration behind the 'Ultimus' - whilst it may be influenced by the past it remains firmly rooted in the present. CASE Graceful and complex, the curvaceous Brunswick silhouette takes its inspiration from a gentleman’s cushion case watch in the Fears archives, first made in 1924 . The Brunswick’s elegant 40.5mm cushion-shaped case has no flat surfaces with graceful curves machined from 316L stainless steel, to a level usually reserved for precious metals. The depth of the polish showcases the sophistication of the machinery and the skill of the operator. The traditional and bespoke ‘onion’-shaped winding crown, signed with the Fears Cypher, has fine grooves catch the light, adding a touch of radiance to the edge of the case. To commemorate this special collaboration, the AMW logo is engraved subtly on the underside of one of the lugs Caseback The 'Ultimus' is fitted with an open exhibition caseback, offering and an unobstructed view of the finely decorated movement (and custom Fears Blue rotor adorned with the Bristol flower). DIAL The 'Ultimus' contains the most complex dial seen on a Fears' watch and being a ‘jump hour’ watch there are no hour numerals on the dial itself rather in this instance the entirety of the rotating hour disc can be seen through the dial. This special dial features three different sapphire elements forming a transparent construction that sits above the hour display, revealing the mechanism below, which is normally hidden. Outer Dial – sapphire (with black gradient) Minute Track - frosted and semi-transparent Inner Dial – a textured luminous ceramic surface The 'Ultimus' marks the only example within the Fears Jump Hour lineage that doesn't have a window cut-out of the dial at 12 o'clock and instead features an integrated magnifying window to display the hour. In daylight the 'Ultimus' is a sleek and considered expression of Fears' design language and philosophy, however when in low-light it transforms and a second personality emerges. The luminous ceramic centre and hour disc create a deep blue glow that permeates up and through the entire dial demonstrating another very distinct visual display. HAND With the hours displayed neatly in a window, only one hand is required for telling the time. The ‘Fears-shaped’ minute hand includes dual-finishing - one half is hand-polished to a mirror shine whilst the other is frosted. This combination of finishing techniques ensure perfect legibility at all angles (even in low light conditions) and for the Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Ultimus' has then been coated in black PVD. MOVEMENT The Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour is powered by a Swiss made, automatic winding JJ01 movement with a module developed in-house by Christopher Ward (which was originally used in the Fears x Christopher Ward Alliance 01 and is now only exclusively supplied for use by Fears). Powered by a Sellita SW200, this movement is incredibly accurate, having been regulated to Chronometer grade. STRAP The Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Ultimus' is offered on a handmade Obsidian Black Epsom Leather strap. Epsom leather is a premium leather prized for it's unique texture and durability - the pebble pattern embossed onto the surface gives it both a distinctive look as well as a higher resistance to scrat

watches.name: Brunswick 40 'Helmsman' ES
watches.description: The yachting Fears Please note: the Brunswick 40 'Helmsman' ES is currently out of stock and pre-orders placed now will be shipping again from February Hand-built in Britain. The Brunswick 40 'Helmsman' ES joins it's counterpart in the Redcliff family as Fears' second model to carry the Endurance Specification designation. The 'Helmsman' ES is yachting-designed and has been created specifically to elegantly cater for the needs of those who find themselves regularly at the helm of a yacht or boat. Case : 40mm, stainless steel, fully brushed, 20mm lug width Dial : Bright White, textured matte lacquer, blue printing (and Grade A Super-LumiNova®) Strap: Sailcloth white, FKM rubber (w/ matching brushed buckle) Movement: LJP G101. time only, automatic, 68hr power reserve Water Resistance: 200 metres (20 ATM) Graceful and complex, the curvaceous Brunswick 40 'Helmsman' ES takes its inspiration from a gentleman’s cushion case watch in the Fears archives, first made in 1924 and seen here in it's sportiest execution. CASE The Brunswick 40 'Helmsman' ES’ elegant yet sporty 40mm cushion-shaped case has no flat surfaces. The case’s glancing curves are machined from 316L stainless steel, to a level usually reserved for precious metals and in this example features an entirely brushed finish to reduce distracting reflections from the sun or glints from the water. Complementing the case is our bespoke ‘onion’-shaped winding screw down crown that has been signed with the Fears Cypher and this particular model has been uprated to an enhanced 200m (20 ATM) of water resistance (to ensure soaking in open water will have no impact on performance). Caseback The Brunswick 40 'Helmsman' ES is offered exclusively with an open exhibition caseback, offering and an unobstructed view of the finely decorated movement (and custom Fears Blue rotor adorned with the Bristol flower). DIAL The Brunswick 40 'Helmsman' ES' dial has been designed for the needs when yachting with a matte white textured surface (to reduce glare) set against Marine Blue elsewhere on the dial to provide the highest possible contrast (aiding legibility). The hand-applied numerals (where the 12, 3, 6 and 9 hour markers are realised in numerical form with the remainder as indices) are milled from a block of brass before being diamond polished, coated in Blue PVD and then filled with Grade A Super-LumiNova ®. HANDS The Brunswick 40 'Helmsman' ES' distinctive ‘ Fears ’-shaped hands are milled from solid brass and polished with a diamond tipped tool. This results in a highly polished surface that catches the light, giving excellent legibility in low-light conditions. These hands are finished in a coating of Blue PVD (that perfectly matches the polished numerals) and then filled with the same Grade A Super-LumiNova ® as the applied indices. MOVEMENT The Brunswick 40 'Helmsman' ES is powered by a customised Swiss-made, automatic La Joux-Perret G101 movement. Winding itself when worn on the wrist this movement boasts a generous power reserve of 68 hours and a decorated winding rotor. STRAP The Brunswick 40 'Helmsman' ES is fitted to an FKM rubber strap in Sailcloth White (finished with contrast stitching in a marine blue) textured in the mould to look like it's woven. The application of FKM rubber retains the classic aesthetic of sailcloth whilst modernising the feel and durability which results in a strap that is supremely comfortable but also extremely hard-wearing. Lined in a waterproof rubber and is finished with Fears' bespoke pin buckle (featuring the Fears Cypher) that has been brushed to perfectly match the case finish. Customise You can customise your Brunswick 40 'Helmsman' ES with any strap designed for a 20mm lug width, including any strap from our range , which you can easily fit yourself without tools. The Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Barleycorn Plum' has a rhodium coated hand (to match the applied hour aperture and bevelling elsewhere on the dial). watches.description: The Pastel Collection Hand built in England. Case : 39.5mm, 316L stainless steel, brushed and polished, 20mm lug width Dial : Sherbet Yellow, matte lacquer, white printing (and featuring Grade A Super-LumiNova®) Strap : Brown, Alcantara®, handmade Bracelet : 3-link, stainless steel bracelet with screw links and fold-over clasp with micro-adjust Movement : LJP G101, time only, automatic, 68hr power reserve Water Resistance : 150 metres (15 ATM) CASE The Redcliff 39.5 is housed in a contemporary round case with integrated lugs alongside a screw-down case back, bezel and crown. The Sherbet Yellow features a lighter yellow matte-lacquer inner dial and a darker yellow outer dial with a white printed minute track (and the subtle inclusion of lume on each of the 5-minute numerals). Taking its inspiration from the tangy sherbet confectionary loved by many as a child (and adult!). HANDS The Redcliff 39.5 Sherbet Yellow's distinctive ‘ Fears ’-shaped hands are tri-bevelled and painted in a matte white varnish (thus matching the baton hour markers) to provide the greatest contrast (and legibility) against the vibrancy of the dial. The hour and minute hands have then been filled with Grade A Super-LumiNova. MOVEMENT The Redcliff 39.5 is powered by a customised Swiss-made, automatic La Joux-Perret G101 movement. Winding itself when worn on the wrist this movement features a generous power reserve of 68 hours and a decorated winding rotor. STRAP The Redcliff 39.5 Sherbet Yellow is offered on a handmade Flax Alcantara® strap , this unique khaki shade and texture tonally matches the minute track whilst perfectly complementing the main section of the dial. Alcantara® (a cutting-edge material developed in Italy) offers unrivalled aesthetic, technical and tactile qualities. Whilst being similar to suede, it is far more hard-wearing (and crucially, is also water-resistant) and in addition to being commonly found in the interiors of luxury sports cars it offers excellent properties as a watch strap. Lined in a premium anti-allergenic calf leather in our signature Fears Blue and embossed with both our logo and ‘Handmade in Belgium’. This is both soft and comfortable and will extend the lifetime of your strap. Both straps are finished with Fears' bespoke pin buckle (featuring the Fears Cypher). watches.name: Brunswick 40 Filton 'Raven Black'
watches.description: The Fears pilots watch The Fears Brunswick 40 Filton is the first pilots watch the company has made in it's 180-year history and is a classically styled aviator watch named after (and inspired by) the town (adjacent to Bristol) that boasts an extensive aeronautical history that still extends beyond the modern day. Case : 40mm, stainless steel, brushed and polished, 20mm lug width Dial : Raven Black, sunburst galvanic finish, white printing (and Grade A Super-LumiNova®) Strap : Woodland brown, buffalo leather, handmade Bracelet : 5-link, stainless steel bracelet with screw links and butterfly clasp Movement : LJP G100, time and date, automatic, 68hr power reserve Water Resistance : 150 metres (15 ATM) Graceful and complex, the curvaceous Brunswick 40 Filton takes its inspiration from a gentleman’s cushion case watch in the Fears archives, first made in 1924 and seen here in it's sportiest execution. CASE The Brunswick 40 Filton’s elegant yet sporty 40mm cushion-shaped case has no flat surfaces. The case’s glancing curves are machined from 316L stainless steel, to a level usually reserved for precious metals. The depth of the polish along with the hand grained finish applied to the top of the case’s corners showcase the sophistication of the machinery and the skill of the operator. Complementing the case is our bespoke ‘onion’-shaped winding screw down crown, signed with the Fears Cypher. Screwed into the case, the crown’s fine grooves catch the light, adding a touch of radiance to the edge of the case. Built with uprated proportions, the Brunswick 40 Filton is 150m water resistant (15 ATM), allowing it to be swum in when the crown is screwed all the way in. CASEBACK The Brunswick 40 Filton comes with the option of either: Open exhibition caseback - offering an unobstructed view of the finely decorated movement (and custom Fears Blue rotor adorned with the Bristol flower). Closed caseback - offering the perfect canvas for personalisation with a custom engraving (please discover engraving options here ). DIAL The Brunswick 40 Filton is the first watch in Fears' illustrious history to feature a pilots dial. The 'Raven Black' dial is a deep, pure black sunburst finish inspired by the clarity and architecture of cockpit instruments with a raised outer section cut with radial grooves. Situated above the baton at the 6 o’clock position a date window is cut into the dial revealing a colour-matched date disc featuring numerals in our own bespoke ‘Edwin’ typeset. The window itself features a shallow bevel running around all four sides to aide legibility and this marks the first time a date complication has been seen on the Brunswick 40. The hand-applied numerals (with a bold triangle at 12 and batons at 3, 6 and 9 with the remainder as indices in Fears' iconic Edwin typeface) are matte white painted and have been filled with Grade A Super-LumiNova. HANDS The Brunswick 40 Filton features traditional sword-shaped hands but still in Fears' distinctive pipette style with a white matte painted finish (thus matching the indices) and filled with Grade A Super-LumiNova. The 'Raven Black' has a matching white painted seconds hand, however the central sections of the handset are in black thus creating a 'ghost' effect. MOVEMENT The Brunswick 40 Filton is powered by a customised Swiss-made, automatic La Joux-Perret G100 movement. Winding itself when worn on the wrist this movement boasts a generous power reserve of 68 hours and a decorated winding rotor. STRAP The Brunswick 40 Filton can be fitted with a handmade Woodland Brown strap crafted from Buffalo leather (sourced from the Himalayas) with subtle ivory contrast stitching finely balances heritage cues with modern utility. This premium leather is one of the strongest and most durable which makes it perfect for this model. watches.name: Redcliff 39.5 Date 'Meta Collection'
watches.description: Fears in collaboration with Meta Hand built in England. Please note: this order window has now closed - if you have any further queries or missed the opportunity to order please email enquiries@fearswatches.com As Fears celebrates its 180th and 10th anniversaries simultaneously, the Redcliff model made for the perfect choice as not only was this the silhouette (in a quartz configuration) that the brand was re-launched with in 2016 it also takes it's name from the district of Bristol where the company was first founded in 1846. Case : 39.5mm, 316L stainless steel, brushed and polished, 20mm lug width Bracelet: 3-link, stainless steel bracelet with screw links and fold-over clasp with micro-adjust Movement: LJP G100, time and date, automatic, 68hr power reserve Water Resistance : 150 metres (15 ATM) Dials : Social Blue - painted gradient, white and blue printing Instagradient - painted gradient, pink, purple and white printing 354 Green - painted gradient, white and green printing Straps : Blue, Alcantara®, handmade Fuschia, Alcantara®, handmade Cream, Alcantara®, handmade CASE Each watch in the Redcliff 39.5 Date 'Meta Collection' is housed in a contemporary round case with integrated lugs alongside a screw-down case back, bezel and crown. Spanning 39.5mm in diameter yet with a case thickness of only 9.98mm, this slim case combines a brushed middle-section with the polished finish of the bezel's graceful profile. The proportions of the case and its integrated lugs help ensure the watch will perfectly fit the contours of any wrist. These special editions of the Redcliff in collaboration with Meta are the only releases (outside of the '1846 Edition' we've made for British Watchmakers' Day) to feature the Fears 180 logo (which can be found engraved on the rear side of one of the lugs). CASEBACK The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'Meta Collection' comes with an open exhibition caseback that offers an unobstructed view of our finely decorated movement (and customised Fears-branded rotor) - the first time a Meta collaboration has featured an open caseback. DIALS The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'Meta Collection' features multi-level dials each with gradated central dials (using each of the primary Pantone references for the respective core Meta apps) and share a white painted outer minute track. The baton indexes are crafted from a block of brass before being diamond polished - the 'Instagram' and 'WhatsApp' editions are then painted white whereas the 'Facebook Edition' coated in precious rhodium. The 12 o'clock index on our regular Redcliff Collection features a subtle reference to our heritage (the shape and form of the towers that hoist Bristol's world famous Clifton Suspension Bridge) whereas on the 'Meta Collection' they reference another iconic symbol - the app icon. At 3 o’clock a date windows are cut into the dial revealing colour-matched date discs featuring numerals in our own bespoke ‘Edwin’ typeset. The windows feature a shallow bevel running around all four sides to aid legibility whilst reading the date and give the optical illusion of them appearing larger. The indices have been hand-filled with Grade A Super-LumiNova before being carefully hand-applied to the dials. HANDS The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'Meta Collection' has distinctive ‘ Fears ’-shaped hands that are tri-bevelled and diamond polished. The 'Facebook Edition' has been coated in precious rhodium, whereas the 'Instagram Edition' and 'WhatsApp Edition' have a white painted finish (each thus matching the indices). In low-light conditions, the bright Grade A lume glows with a strong blue-green colour. MOVEMENT The watches in the Redcliff 39.5 Date 'Meta Collection' are powered by a customised Swiss-made, automatic La Joux-Perret G100 movement. Winding itself when worn on the wrist, this movement features a quick-set date, a generous power reserve of 68 hours and a decorated winding rotor. watches.description: Fears in collaboration with Meta Hand built in England. Please note: this order window has now closed - if you have any further queries or missed the opportunity to order please email enquiries@fearswatches.com As Fears celebrates its 180th and 10th anniversaries simultaneously, the Redcliff model made for the perfect choice as not only was this the silhouette (in a quartz configuration) that the brand was re-launched with in 2016 it also takes it's name from the district of Bristol where the company was first founded in 1846. Case : 39.5mm, 316L stainless steel, brushed and polished , 20mm lug width Dial : 354 Green, painted gradient, white and green printing Strap : Cream , Alcantara®, handmade Bracelet : 3-link, stainless steel bracelet with screw links and fold-over clasp with micro-adjust Movement : LJP G100, time and date, automatic, 68hr power reserve Water Resistance : 150 metres (15 ATM) CASE The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'WhatsApp Edition' is housed in a contemporary round case with integrated lugs alongside a screw-down case back, bezel and crown. Spanning 39.5mm in diameter yet with a case thickness of only 9.98mm, this slim case combines a brushed middle-section with the polished finish of the bezel's graceful profile. The proportions of the case and its integrated lugs help ensure the watch will perfectly fit the contours of any wrist. These special editions of the Redcliff in collaboration with Meta are the only releases (outside of the '1846 Edition' we've made for British Watchmakers' Day) to feature the Fears 180 logo (which can be found engraved on the rear side of one of the lugs). CASEBACK The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'WhatsApp Edition' comes with an open exhibition caseback that offers an unobstructed view of our finely decorated movement (and customised Fears-branded rotor) - the first time a Meta collaboration has featured an open caseback. DIAL The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'WhatsApp Edition' features a multi-level dial with a gradated green central dial (using the primary WhatsApp Pantone references) with a white painted outer minute track. The baton indexes are crafted from a block of brass before being diamond polished and white painted finish. The 12 o'clock index on our regular Redcliff Collection features a subtle reference to our heritage (the shape and form of the towers that hoist Bristol's world famous Clifton Suspension Bridge) whereas on the 'Meta Collection' they reference another iconic symbol - the app icon. At 3 o’clock a date window is cut into the dial revealing a colour-matched date disc featuring numerals in our own bespoke ‘Edwin’ typeset. The window itself features a shallow bevel running around all four sides to aid legibility whilst reading the date and gives the optical illusion of it appearing larger. The indices have been hand-filled with Grade A Super-LumiNova before being carefully hand-applied to the dial. HANDS The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'WhatsApp Edition' has distinctive ‘ Fears ’-shaped hands that are tri-bevelled, diamond polished and a white painted finish (thus matching the indices). Whilst in low-light conditions, the bright Grade A lume glows with a strong blue-green colour. MOVEMENT The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'WhatsApp Edition' is powered by a customised Swiss-made, automatic La Joux-Perret G100 movement. Winding itself when worn on the wrist, this movement features a quick-set date, a generous power reserve of 68 hours and a decorated winding rotor. BRACELET & STRAP The Redcliff 39.5 Date 'WhatsApp Edition' comes with both our bespoke 3-link stainless steel bracelet and an additional Alcantara ® strap. Bracelet Featuring solid screw links, the bracelet combines brushed and polished elements and has a substantial feel while the silky-smooth movement of the links ensure a comfortable fit around the wrist. The bracelet can be adjusted for a perfect fit with both 6mm and 8mm screw links but also adjusted 'on the move' via a push button micro-adjustment feature located within the trigger-release

watches.name: Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Celestial'
watches.description: The Astronomical Fears The Fears Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Celestial' takes inspiration from the beauty of the night sky and transposes that on to our iconic Jump Hour. The fusion of an aventurine glass outer ring with a mother of pearl centrepiece visually evokes a full moon set against a clear sky full of stars. Case : 40.5mm, stainless steel, brushed and polished, 20mm lug width Dial : Astral Blue colour, aventurine glass and mother of pearl, silver printing Strap : Fears Blue, barenia calf leather, handmade Bracelet: 5-link, stainless steel bracelet with screw links and butterfly clasp Movement : Christopher Ward's JJ01 Module, Sellita SW200 base Water Resistance : 100 metres (10 ATM) Limited Edition: 75 Pieces Graceful and complex, the curvaceous Brunswick silhouette takes its inspiration from a gentleman’s cushion case watch in the Fears archives, first made in 1924 . CASE The Brunswick’s elegant 40.5mm cushion-shaped case has no flat surfaces, with even the solid case back having a gentle sweep. The case’s graceful curves are machined from 316L stainless steel, to a level usually reserved for precious metals. The depth of the polish showcases the sophistication of the machinery and the skill of the operator. The traditional and bespoke ‘onion’-shaped winding crown, signed with the Fears Cypher, has fine grooves catch the light, adding a touch of radiance to the edge of the case. CASEBACK The Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Celestial' comes with the option of either: Open exhibition caseback - offering an unobstructed view of the decorated movement (and custom Fears Blue rotor adorned with the Bristol flower) Closed caseback - offering the perfect canvas for personalisation with a custom engraving (please discover engraving options here ) DIAL Expertly made in Germany this complex dial is a dual-material composition intended to evoke a full moon set against a clear night sky. This special dial is complimented by a set of bespoke Breguet-style numerals that have been developed in-house - their appearance on the Celestial marks the first time this typography has been seen on a modern Fears watch. Outer Dial – formed of aventurine glass, specifically chosen for it's deep blue translucency and the presence of fine metallic particles to create a star-like shimmer Inner Dial – a disc of high-grade white mother of pearl, the natural opalescence of which giving the appearance of the moon's glow Encircling the dial is a silver-printed minute track, that has been subtly infused with metallic particles and arranged in a radial layout as an ode to celestial mapping (charting the position of the stars) thus reinforcing the design's astronomical theme. As this a ‘jump hour’ watch there are no hour numerals on the dial, instead the hour is displayed via a window at 12 o’clock. The disc displaying these numerals is coated in a bright white lacquer before the hours are printed in glossy black ink in this newly-developed bespoke Breguet-style typeface. The hour window is surrounded by a hand-applied silver ring, coated in precious Rhodium that has been machined with bevels before being finished by hand with brushed and polished surfaces. These multiple finishes catch the light while mirroring the polished bezel surrounding the crystal. HAND With the hours of the Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Celestial' displayed neatly in a window, only one hand is required for telling the time. The ‘Fears-shaped’ minute hand has a rhodium coating and includes dual-finishing. Half the hand has been polished to a mirror shine while the other half is brushed to best complement the dial's configuration. The combination of this pair of finishing techniques ensure perfect legibility at all angles, even in low light conditions. MOVEMENT The Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour is powered by a Swiss made, automatic winding JJ01 movement with a module developed in-house by Christopher Ward (which was originally used in the Fears x Christopher Ward Alliance 01 and is now only exclusive

watches.name: Brunswick 40 '1846 Edition'
watches.description: The 180th Anniversary Edition Created exclusively for the Alliance of British Watch & Clockmakers British Watchmakers' Day and only available to purchase from the event on the day (7th March, 2026). The Fears Brunswick 40 '1846 Edition' takes a similar form to the stainless steel Brunswick 40, however this edition is slightly slimmer and paired with a brand new movement. M eticulously crafted from precious, hallmarked, Sterling Silver (925). Just 25 pieces of these precious watches have been made, each numbered and featuring a dial inspired and influenced by the first pocket watch Edwin Fear made in 1846. This special piece completes the trifecta of Fears Sterling Silver models after the 'Edwardian Edition' (2025) and '1924 Edition' (2024) made for previous British Watchmakers' Days . Case : 40mm, Sterling Silver (925), polished, 20mm lug width Dial : White, dual-section lacquered finish with black printing Strap : Fears Blue, pigs leather, handmade Movement : LJP G121M, time only, manual winding Water Resistance : 100 metres (10 ATM) Limited Edition : 25 pieces only Price : £4,350 (inc. VAT) The '1846 Edition' will be exclusively available to purchase at the event, but if you wish to be added to the waitlist for an remaining pieces (or have early access to similar releases) please contact us . CASE Graceful and complex, the curvaceous Brunswick silhouette takes its inspiration from a gentleman’s cushion case watch in the Fears archives, first made in 1924 . The '1846 Edition's elegant 40mm cushion-shaped case has no flat surfaces, with even the solid case back having a gentle sweep. This special edition is made from solid Sterling Silver and crafted entirely from this understated metal, the case’s glancing curves are machined from 925 Sterling Silver with a deep polish all over, highlighting the beauty and radiance of the metal. The case and the solid caseback each bear hallmarks from the London Assay Office, and, following a Fears tradition, our company's registered makers mark comprise the initials of the Managing Director when the watch was built (in this case: ‘NBS’ for our (4th) Managing Director, Nicholas Bowman-Scargill). The bespoke silver ‘onion’-shaped winding crown has fine grooves that catch the light, adding a touch of radiance to the edge of the case. This crown is set with a diamond (which on a Fears watch signifies a case made entirely from a precious metal). DIAL Multiple layers of hand-polished pure white lacquer make up this dial inspired by Edwin Fear's original 1846 pocket watch. It's dual-section enamel-style construction offers depth and clarity which is then accentuated by a large recessed sub-seconds. The Fears makers mark, alongside this set of Roman numerals, are a recreation of how they appeared on dials in the late-1840s when Fears was first established. HANDS The Fears Brunswick 40 '1846 Edition' spade-shaped hands are a homage to those found in the Fears Archive from Edwin Fear's original pocket watch in 1846 and onwards. Each set of hands have been thermally-blued by a flame in the same way Fears hands would have been made over a century ago. This traditional method of thermally hardening the steel results in a finish that will flit from almost black to electric blue as they catch the light. MOVEMENT The Brunswick 40 '1846 Edition' is powered by a new calibre from La Joux-Perret - the Swiss-made, manual winding, LJP G121M movement. This movement is the top-grade version, with an impressive 60-hour power reserve. The architecture positions the seconds mechanism further from the centre of the dial which allows in this execution for an enlarged sub-seconds (echoing that of the pocket watches it's inspired by). STRAP The Brunswick 40 '1846 Edition' is fitted with a handmade Fears Blue strap crafted from pigs leather with tonal stitching and fold-over edges that reflects Fears' heritage whilst retaining a premium feel. This soft and supple leather has a buttery feel with a dimpled surface and was wi

watches.name: Brunswick 38 'De Stijl Edition' (exclusively for Ace Jewelers)
watches.description: Dutch creativity meets British refinement Please note: t he Brunswick 38 'De Stijl Edition' can only be purchased directly from Ace Jewelers . The Brunswick 38 'De Stijl Edition' marks the first collaboration between Fears Watch Company and Ace Jewelers since announcing Ace as Fears exclusive retailer in the Netherlands. This special collaboration connects Amsterdam to Bristol in a creative partnership that synthesises Dutch creativity with British refinement and has been inspired by the De Stijl art movement that's thus been reinterpreted through geometry and colour. Case : 38mm, stainless steel, polished, 20mm lug width Dial : White polished lacquer, with multi-colour printing Strap : Black, buffalo leather, handmade Movement : LJP D100, time only, manual winding Water Resistance : 100 metres (10 ATM) Price - €3400 (excluding sales tax) CASE The Brunswick’s elegant 38mm cushion-shaped case has no flat surfaces. The case’s graceful curves are machined from 316L stainless steel, to a level usually reserved for precious metals. The depth of the polish showcases the sophistication of the machinery and the skill of the operator. The Brunswick 38 is manually wound each day using our bespoke ‘onion’-shaped winding crown, signed with the Fears Cypher. The crown’s fine grooves catch the light, adding a touch of radiance to the edge of the case. CASEBACK The Brunswick 38 'De Stijl Edition' comes an open exhibition caseback - offering an unobstructed view of the finely decorated movement housed inside. Each caseback is engraved with the individual edition number. DIAL The Brunswick 38 'De Stijl Edition' features a hand-polished white lacquer dial, expertly made in Germany by one of the world’s finest dial makers. After several layers of white lacquer are applied, multiple layers of crisp black, grey, blue, yellow and red ink are applied to bring the De Stijl movement to life. What appears at first to be purely abstract composition reveals upon closer inspection a subtle logic for telling the time as Fear's Design Manager (Lee Yuen-Rapati) explains: “W hile the dial may appear completely abstract, functional elements such as the hour markers can still be found hidden in the corners of each of the black rectangles. The design embodies De Stijl’s ideals of universality within distilled abstraction ". HANDS The Brunswick 38 'De Stijl Edition' features iconic ‘Fears’-shaped skeletonised hands expertly made in Germany. The hour and minute hands are painted black to match the indices and the seconds hand is painted white (to match the dial base and provide maximum legibility against the squared sub-dial). MOVEMENT The Brunswick 38 'De Stijl Edition' is powered by a Swiss-made, manual winding La Joux-Perret D100 movement. This movement is the top-grade version, with an extended 50 hour power reserve and finished with Côtes de Genève and blued screws. STRAP The Brunswick 38 'De Stijl Edition' can be fitted with a handmade Raven Black strap crafted from Buffalo leather (sourced from the Himalayas), lending a more sophisticated feel to the watch. This premium leather is some of the strongest and most durable available. This leather has been tanned in the same way it has been for centuries, using organic materials (and not modern techniques that utilise chemicals). It is not stretched during the tanning process, so is thicker more hard-wearing as a result. Lined in genuine Alcantara® dyed a deep shade of blue, this lining is supremely soft against the skin yet resistant against wear. This strap is finished with Fears' new bespoke pin buckle (featuring the Fears Cypher) . INDIVIDUALLY NUMBERED Each watch we make carries a unique serial number. Engraved between the 20mm lugs at 12 o’clock, this number helps us identify your watch and its history. watches.name: Blush Pink
watches.description: Our straps are meticulously handcrafted by a family-run atelier in Belgium specialising in beautiful, premium watch straps. Material Handcrafted from Alcantara (a cutting-edge material developed in Italy) that offers unrivalled aesthetic, technical and tactile qualities. Whilst similar to suede, it is far more hard-wearing (and crucially, is water-resistant) and whilst commonly found in the interior of luxury sports cars it offers excellent properties as a watch strap. Colour A soft and soothing pale blush pink that captures the warmth of an early dawn - delicate yet confident this romantic shade evokes a calm elegance. Surface Finish Alcantara is extremely soft to touch and provides a luxurious feel - it has a similar feel to the nap of suede but is considerably harder-wearing with a supple feel. Lining Lined in a premium anti-allergenic calf leather and embossed with both our logo and ‘Handmade in Belgium’ - this is both soft and comfortable and will extend the lifetime of your strap. Buckle Please note; the image shows our legacy buckle whereas this strap is now finished with Fears' new bespoke pin buckle (featuring the Fears Cypher). Size Designed to fit all Fears Redcliff, Brunswick and Archival watches, this strap will also fit any watch with a 20mm lug width . The strap is available in two sizes: Standard fits wrists measuring 178 - 210mm (approx.) Shorter fits wrists measuring 164 - 197mm (approx.) Fit yourself Featuring Quick-Release spring bars , our straps can be fitted and removed from the watch using no tools. This means you can change it over in a matter of moments with no hassle.

watches.description: The contemporary vintage Fears Hand-built in Britain in small batches. A contemporary expression of Fears’ iconic cushion-shaped silhouette, the Brunswick 38 ‘Charcoal Rose’ re-imagines classic elegance with a multi-tonal dial drawing inspiration from the gentle hues regularly seen in vintage Fears pieces. Case : 38mm, stainless steel, polished, 20mm lug width Dial : Granular black textured, with 18ct rose-gold plating and hand-applied numerals Strap : Brown, Cordovan leather, handmade / 5-link, stainless steel bracelet with screw links and butterfly clasp Movement : LJP D100, time only, manual winding Water Resistance : 100 metres (10 ATM) CASE The Brunswick’s elegant 38mm cushion-shaped case has no flat surfaces. The case’s graceful curves are machined from 316L stainless steel, to a level usually reserved for precious metals. The depth of the polish showcases the sophistication of the machinery and the skill of the operator. The Brunswick 38 'Charcoal Rose' is manually wound each day using our bespoke ‘onion’-shaped winding crown, signed with the Fears Cypher. The crown’s fine grooves catch the light, adding a touch of radiance to the edge of the case. CASEBACK The Brunswick 38 'Charcoal Rose' comes with the option of either: Open exhibition caseback - offering an unobstructed view of the finely decorated movement housed inside. Closed caseback - offering the perfect canvas for personalisation with a custom engraving (please discover engraving options here ). DIAL The Brunswick 38 'Charcoal Rose' reimagines classic elegance with a contemporary multi-tonal dial that draws inspiration from the subtle hues found throughout the Fears' Archive. Its granular textured charcoal base provides an sophisticated backdrop for the accents of 18ct rose gold (the first time this finish has featured in the modern Fears era). Expertly made in Germany, this multi-level dial feature a granular charcoal finish on the main central section, with the prominent sunken sub-seconds at 6 o'clock and the minute track seen here with a fine concentric guilloche finish in 18ct rose gold. The hand-applied numerals are milled from a block of brass before being diamond polished, frosted, a base coating in pure silver and then finished in 18ct rose gold, giving them a bright and unmissable appearance. In order to strike an equal balance between classic and contemporary we've developed a special wider set of our proprietary 'Edwin' numerals specifically for this reference. HANDS The Brunswick 38 'Charcoal Rose' features iconic ‘ Fears ’-shaped hands expertly made in Germany, they are milled from solid brass with a bevel cut down the centre using a diamond tool . The hour and minute hands feature a lightly frosted finish before receiving their coating of 18ct rose gold to perfectly match the polished 3D numerals, whereas the seconds hand is coated in contrasting black varnish. MOVEMENT The Brunswick 38 'Charcoal Rose' is powered by a Swiss-made, manual winding La Joux-Perret D100 movement. This movement is the top-grade version, with an extended 50 hour power reserve and finished with Côtes de Genève and blued screws. STRAP The Brunswick 38 'Charcoal Rose' is fitted with a handmade Chestnut Brown strap crafted from the finest Cordovan leathe r with premium fold-over edges. T his exceptional leather represents the art of tanning at it's finest and is sourced from the shell membrane of a horsehide that is ordinarily reserved for the worlds finest shoemakers. This ultra-premium leather requires at least six months to complete the complex labour-intensive tanning process that spans several stages but results in a smooth texture with a deep lustre and an unmatched durability. Lined in genuine Alcantara® dyed a deep shade of blue, this lining is supremely soft against the skin yet resistant against wear. This strap is finished with Fears' bespoke pin buckle (featuring the Fears Cypher). BRACELET The Brunswick 38 'Charcoal Rose' is also available to purchase with Fear

watches.name: Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Barleycorn Plum'
watches.description: The evolution of the Jump Hour Please note: the Jump Hour has now entered the Fears Archive (however our Fears Authorised Stockists may still have pieces available and you can find your nearest stockist here ) The Fears Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour again takes centre-stage in the Fears collection as the Brunswick 40.5 'Barleycorn Plum' sees the design language evolve a step further as we embark on the next chapter of the Jump Hour. Case : 40.5mm, stainless steel, brushed and polished, 20mm lug width Dial : Silverwhite colour, barleycorn pattern, rhodium-plating with plum lacquer Straps : Plum and Storm Grey, both Alcantara ®, both handmade Bracelet: 5-link, stainless steel bracelet with screw links and butterfly clasp Movement : Christopher Ward's JJ01 Module, Sellita SW200 base Water Resistance : 100 metres (10 ATM) Hand built in Britain. Graceful and complex, the curvaceous Brunswick silhouette takes its inspiration from a gentleman’s cushion case watch in the Fears archives, first made in 1924 . CASE The Brunswick’s elegant 40.5mm cushion-shaped case has no flat surfaces, with even the solid case back having a gentle sweep. The case’s graceful curves are machined from 316L stainless steel, to a level usually reserved for precious metals. The depth of the polish showcases the sophistication of the machinery and the skill of the operator. The traditional and bespoke ‘onion’-shaped winding crown, signed with the Fears Cypher, has fine grooves catch the light, adding a touch of radiance to the edge of the case. CASEBACK The Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Barleycorn Plum' comes with the option of either: Open exhibition caseback - the first time this has been available on a Jump Hour, offering an unobstructed view of the decorated movement (and custom Fears Blue rotor adorned with the Bristol flower) Closed caseback - offering the perfect canvas for personalisation with a custom engraving (please discover engraving options here ) DIAL Expertly made and inspired by nature, this 3D barleycorn patterned dial offers a compelling fusion of artistry and innovation. Balancing the hour window on the upper side of the dial is a finely brushed and bevelled plate set into the lower side of the dial bearing the Fears name. Outer Dial – a distinct barleycorn pattern radiating from the centre of the dial that has been coated in pure silver (which then dazzles from bright white to silver depending on the light) Inner Dial – a rich plum matte lacquer that offers a bold yet sophisticated contrast As this a ‘jump hour’ watch there are no hour numerals on the dial, instead the hour is displayed via a window at 12 o’clock. The disc displaying these numerals is coated in a bright white lacquer before the hours are printed in glossy black ink in Fears bespoke ‘Edwin’ typeface that's been enhanced for display in a round window. The hour window is surrounded by a hand-applied silver ring, coated in precious Rhodium that has been machined with bevels before being finished by hand with brushed and polished surfaces. These multiple finishes catch the light while mirroring the polished bezel surrounding the crystal. HAND With the hours displayed neatly in a window, only one hand is required for telling the time. The ‘Fears-shaped’ minute hand includes dual-finishing with half the hand polished to a mirror shine while the other half is frosted and the other half a finish that best complements the dial configuration. The combination of this pair of finishing techniques ensure perfect legibility at all angles, even in low light conditions. The Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Barleycorn Plum' has a rhodium coated hand (to match the applied hour aperture and bevelling elsewhere on the dial). MOVEMENT The Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour is powered by a Swiss made, automatic winding JJ01 movement with a module developed in-house by Christopher Ward (which was originally used in the Fears x Christopher Ward Alliance 01 and is now only exclusively supplied for use by Fears). watches.name: Redcliff 39.5 'ES'
watches.description: Fears' first tool watch of the modern era Hand-built in Britain in small batches. The Redcliff 39.5 'Endurance Specification' is Fears' first modern tool watch that embraces modern sportiness and offers a new level of robust capability whilst still retaining the elegance and sophistication that makes a Fears' timepiece. Case : 39.5mm, 316L stainless steel, frosted and hardened to 2,000 HV - 9x harder than regular stainless steel (DLC finish for the; crown, bezel and caseback), 20mm lug width Dial : Carbon black, textured finish, stepped minute track, white and orange printing with moulded X2 Grade SuperLumiNova ® Strap : Black FKM rubber (w/ orange stitching), deployant clasp (w/ matching frosted DLC finish) Movement : LJP G100, time and date, automatic, 68hr power reserve Water Resistance : 150 metres (15 ATM) CASE The Redcliff 39.5 'ES' is housed in a contemporary round case with integrated lugs alongside a screw-down case back, bezel and crown that spans 39.5mm in diameter yet with a case thickness of only 9.98mm. Each part of the case (including the buckle) have first been frosted before undergoing a special hardening treatment to achieve an uprated 2,000 Vickers (9x the hardness of standard 316L Stainless Steel) that renders this Fears' tool watch practically indestructible. The most exposed components (bezel, crown and exhibition caseback) have also been given a DLC (Diamond-Like Carbon) coating to further enhance durability and scratch-resistance. DIAL The Redcliff 39.5 'ES' features one of the most complex dials Fears have ever produced. Expertly made in Germany, this multi-level dial with an steeply angled rehaut and sunken central section finished in a carbon black anti-glare texture with white and orange printing. At 3 o’clock a date window is cut into the dial revealing a colour-matched date disc featuring numerals in our own bespoke ‘Edwin’ typeset. The window itself features a shallow bevel running around all four sides to aide legibility whilst reading the date and gives the optical illusion of it appearing larger. The baton indexes are crafted from a moulded X2 -Grade Super-LumiNova blocks (the newly released top grade) that have been meticulously hand-applied to the dial and offer a significantly longer and more pronounced glow. As with the rest of the Redcliff collection, the 12 o'clock index also features a subtle reference to another great Bristolian historical reference (the shape and form of the towers that hoist the famous Clifton Suspension Bridge). HANDS The Redcliff 39.5 'ES' features distinctive ‘ Fears ’-shaped hands that have the same X2-Grade Super-LumiNova set inside. The minute and hour hands are finished in a white matte paint with a contrasting orange matte painted seconds hand. MOVEMENT The Redcliff 39.5 'ES is powered by a customised Swiss-made, automatic La Joux-Perret G100 movement. Winding itself when worn on the wrist this movement features a quick-set date, a generous power reserve of 68 hours and a decorated winding rotor. STRAP The Redcliff 39.5 'ES' is fitted to an FKM rubber strap in Carbon Black (finished with a vivid orange contrast stitching) moulded to look like it's woven. The application of FKM rubber retains the classic aesthetic of sailcloth whilst modernising the feel and durability which results in a strap that is supremely comfortable but also extremely hard-wearing. Lined in a waterproof rubber and is finished with a bespoke dual trigger deployant buckle engraved with the Fears cypher that has been treated to same frosting, hardening and DLC coating as the case middle. Customise You can customise your Redcliff 39.5 with any strap designed for a 20mm lug width, including any strap from our range , which you can easily fit yourself without tools. Please Note Due to the different style of finishing on this particular case our bespoke 3-Link Redcliff bracelet is not compatible with this ES model. watches.name: Brunswick 40 ‘Odyssey Edition’
watches.description: A British world record attempt Please note: the Fears Brunswick 40 'Odyssey Edition' has now sold out The Fears Brunswick 40 'Odyssey Edition' is a unique timepiece made to commemorate the Great British Odyssey and is a special limited-edition version taking design cues and direct inspiration from the EXPERIMENTAL 01 watch that Angus Collins will be wearing during his Great British Odyssey (GBO) challenge of which Fears are the official timekeeping partner. A portion of each Brunswick 40 'Odyssey Edition' sale will be donated to James' Place , the charity partner of GBO that saves the lives of men in suicidal crisis. Case : 40mm, stainless steel, brushed and polished, 20mm lug width Dial : White colour, with black and red printing and hand-applied indices (featuring X1-Grade Super-LumiNova ® ) Straps : Fears Blue FKM rubber, deployant clasp / Orange MN™ elasticated textile Movement : LJP G101, time-only, automatic, decorated rotor, 68hr power reserve Water Resistance : 150 metres (15 ATM) Limited Edition: 100 pieces Graceful and complex, the curvaceous Brunswick 40 takes its inspiration from a gentleman’s cushion case watch in the Fears archives, first made in 1924 . This sportier iteration of the Brunswick is the perfect all-round watch, taking you from beach to boardroom with ease. CASE The Brunswick 40’s elegant yet sporty 40mm cushion-shaped case has no flat surfaces. The case’s glancing curves are machined from 316L stainless steel, to a level usually reserved for precious metals. The depth of the polish along with the hand grained finish applied to the top of the case’s corners showcase the sophistication of the machinery and the skill of the operator. Complementing the case is our bespoke ‘onion’-shaped winding screw down crown, signed with the Fears Cypher. Screwed into the case, the crown’s fine grooves catch the light, adding a touch of radiance to the edge of the case. Built with uprated proportions, the Brunswick 40 is 150m water resistant (15 ATM), allowing it to be swum in when the crown is screwed all the way in. DIAL The Brunswick 40 'Odyssey Edition' dial shares the layout, special texture and design with EXPERIMENTAL 01 but with an elevated degree of elegance. Expertly made in Germany, the textured surface of the dial is on two levels, both of which are in a practical yet elegant anti-glare white matte lacquer finish. The minute track and Fears name are printed in black, while the 1/4 hour minutes are picked out in an elegant deep red. The hand-applied numerals (where the 12, 3, 6 and 9 hour markers are realised in numerical form with the remainder as indices) are milled from a block of brass before being diamond polished, coated in Fears Blue PVD and then filled with X1-grade Super-LumiNova ® (that emits a cool blue once charged). HANDS The Brunswick 40 ' Odyssey Edition' distinctive ‘ Fears ’-shaped hands are milled from solid brass and polished with a diamond tipped tool. This results in a highly polished surface that catches the light, giving excellent legibility in low-light conditions. These hands are finished in a coating of Fears Blue PVD (that perfectly matches the polished 3D numerals) and then filled with the same X1-Grade Super-LumiNova ® as the applied indices. Whilst in low-light conditions, the bright X1-Grade lume (a first for a Brunswick 40 entering the Fears core collection) glows with a cool blue colour colour and stays charged throughout the night - making for the perfect travelling companion. MOVEMENT The Brunswick 40 is powered by a customised Swiss-made, automatic La Joux-Perret G101 movement (that has had the date function removed). Winding itself when worn on the wrist this movement boasts a generous power reserve of 68 hours and a decorated winding rotor. watches.name: Arnos Pewter Blue
watches.description: The rectangular Fears Hand-built in Britain in small batches. The Fears Arnos Collection continues the tradition of naming our core watch families after locations in Bristol with historic relevance to Fears. Arnos Vale is the area where the Fears headquarters are located today, but also the home to the cemetery where both our original founder (Edwin Fear) and his son and successor (Amos Daniel Fear) happen to be buried. The Fears Arnos Pewter Blue is the first piece in this new collection, that focuses on modern watches with an angular case shape. The Fears Archive is well stocked with elegant rectangular watches, all with this distinctive tall and thin silhouette. Case: Curved 22.6 x 40mm (end of lugs), stainless steel, brushed and polished, 20mm lug width Dial: Pewter Blue colour, hobnail pattern, rhodium-plated with white printing Strap: Comes with two straps: Taupe, Barenia calf leather, hand-sewn & Fears Blue smooth FKM rubber Movement: Sellita SW1000-1b, time only, automatic Water Resistance: 30 metres (3 ATM) The Arnos Pewter Blue builds upon Fears' established design language taking it to a new level of sophistication. CASE The Arnos ' slim and elegant rectangular case takes inspiration from the rectangular watches in the Fears Archive dating from the 1920s and 30s. The Arnos case is expertly machined from 316L Stainless Steel, in Switzerland, to a level usually reserved for precious metals. This precisely milled case has then been finished with a combination of linearly brushed and highly polished surfaces. This tall, slim watch is supremely comfortable due to its elegantly curved profile - the crystal, case and caseback all possess the same matching curvature that maps the contours of the wrist perfectly. Complementing the case is a new bespoke (subtly onion-shaped, yet contemporary) winding crown, signed with the Fears Cypher. DIAL Expertly made in Germany, the Arnos Pewter Blue dial features the striking combination of a blue circle within a grey rectangle - the 'inner dial' leaves a large negative space that forms the rectangular 'outer dial'. Outer Dial – a distinct hobnail pattern cut by a CNC machine at a precisely-defined angle, then coated in precious Rhodium Inner Dial – constructed from a separate section, which has been machine-turned with a concentric pattern before being coated in galvanic blue This unique dial then features a set of contemporary-styled roman numerals (the first time they've featured on a core model in the modern Fears era) crisply printed in white. HANDS The Arnos uses solid ‘Fears pipette’ shaped hands that feature a central diamond-cut bevel down each edge and the tip, before being coated in a Rhodium plating. The expertly three-way mirror polished surfaces will catch the light brilliantly and thus enhance legibility. MOVEMENT The Arnos is powered by a top-grade Swiss-made, automatic Sellita SW1000 movement (that has been customised for Fears to display just hours / minutes). Winding itself when worn on the wrist, this small but mighty movement offers a power reserve of 46 hours and features a Fears Blue decorated rotor (which as per Fears tradition, also features the flower of Bristol motif). STRAPS Each Arnos Pewter Blue comes complete with two straps that have been specially made for this model by Delugs (a special customised offering to mark the first time we have partnered with them). Taupe Barenia Leather The Arnos Pewter Blue is fitted with a hand-sewn Taupe toned strap crafted from Barenia leather that features a premium fold-over edge for a slim and elegant look. The premium leather used for this strap takes its name from the village of Barr in Alsace, from where it originates. Traditionally used for saddles, this smooth calfskin leather requires a complex tanning process, known by only a small number of craftsmen. watches.name: Redcliff 39.5 Burlingame Edition 'Confetti'
watches.description: A totem of celebration The Redcliff 39.5 'Confetti' marks the first of a new collection of limited-production (but not limited edition) watches by Topper Jewelers - entitled Burlingame Editions. This collaboration holds a significant importance for the Fears team and the Caplan family, as the 'Confetti' dial concept was designed by John Caplan shortly before successfully completing chemotherapy and was intended as a reminder of life's best moments - and those that should be celebrated. This special collaboration can only be purchased directly from Topper Jewelers . Case : 39.5mm, 316L stainless steel, brushed and polished , 20mm lug width Dial : Pale ivory, painted, with multi-coloured printing Bracelet : 3-link, stainless steel bracelet with screw links and fold-over clasp with micro-adjust (plus an grey textile strap) Movement : LJP G101, time only, automatic, 68hr power reserve Burlingame Edition : Only available from Topper Jewelers Price - $3700 A portion of the proceeds from each watch sold will be donated to support the world-renowned oncology research being conducted at the Lucile Packard Children's Hospital. CASE The Redcliff 39.5 'Confetti' is housed in a contemporary round case with integrated lugs alongside a screw-down case back, bezel and crown. Spanning 39.5mm in diameter yet with a case thickness of only 9.98mm, this slim case combines a bushed middle-section with the polished finish of the bezel's graceful profile. DIAL Expertly made in Germany, the Redcliff 39.5 'Confetti' features a delicate ivory-coloured painted base dial which has then been embellished with an all-over confetti motif cast in multi-coloured printing - a totem of celebration for all of life's most important milestones. The baton indexes are crafted from a block of brass before being diamond polished and then coated in black gold, giving them a warm, grey/black appearance. The 12 o'clock index also features a subtle reference to another great Bristolian historical reference (the shape and form of the towers that hoist the famous Clifton Suspension Bridge). Each indices has been hand-filled with X1-Grade Super-LumiNova in Switzerland before being carefully hand-applied to the dial. HANDS The Redcliff 39.5 'Confetti' distinctive ‘ Fears ’-shaped hands are tri-bevelled and diamond polished before in this example being finished in a coating of black gold (thus matching the indices). During the day the tri-bevelled edges will catch the light brilliantly, allowing the time to be read easily. Whilst in low-light conditions, the bright X1-Grade lume (a first for the core collection) glows with a strong blue colour colour and stays charged throughout the night - making for the perfect travelling companion. Complimented by a subtle, yet impactful pastel blue painted seconds hand (which happens to be John Caplan's favourite colour). MOVEMENT The Redcliff 39.5 'Confetti' is powered by a customised Swiss-made, automatic La Joux-Perret G101 movement (that has had the date function removed). Winding itself when worn on the wrist this movement boasts a generous power reserve of 68 hours and a decorated winding rotor concealed by a closed case back. BRACELET & STRAP The Redcliff 39.5 'Confetti' comes with both a bespoke 3-link stainless steel bracelet and a 3D-woven textile straps. Bracelet Featuring solid screw links, the bracelet combines brushed and polished elements and has a substantial feel while the silky-smooth movement of the links ensure a comfortable fit around the wrist. The bracelet can be adjusted for a perfect fit with both 6mm and 8mm screw links but also adjusted 'on the move' via a push button micro-adjustment featured located within the trigger-release fold-over clasp. This ensures a comfortable fit always. watches.description: The Sterling Jump Hour Created exclusively for the Alliance of British Watch & Clockmakers British Watchmakers' Day and only available to purchase from the event on the day (8th March, 2025). The Fears Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Edwardian Edition' takes a similar form to the stainless steel Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour , however, this edition is crafted from precious, hallmarked, sterling silver (925). After last year's British Watchmakers' Day exclusive, the Brunswick 38 '1924 Edition', we felt it right to give our most coveted model the sterling silver treatment. Just 10 pieces of these precious watches will be made, each numbered, hallmarked and featuring a dial inspired and influenced by the Edwardian-era pocket watches found within the Fears Archive. Donation Each watch also comes in a special commemorative packaging and a portion of the profits will be donated to the Alliance of British Watch & Clockmakers . Case : 40.5mm, Sterling Silver (925), polished, 20mm lug width Dial : Porcelain white, polished lacquered finish with black printing Strap : Maple Red , Alcantara®, handmade Movement : Christopher Ward's JJ01 Module, Sellita SW200 base Water Resistance : 100 metres (10 ATM) Limited Edition : 10 pieces only Price : £5,450 (inc. VAT) Hand built in Britain. Graceful and complex, the curvaceous Brunswick silhouette takes its inspiration from a gentleman’s cushion case watch in the Fears archives, first made in 1924 . CASE The 'Edwardian Edition's elegant 40.5mm cushion-shaped case has no flat surfaces, with even the solid case back having a gentle sweep. This special edition is made from solid Sterling Silver and crafted entirely from this understated metal, the case’s glancing curves are machined from 925 Sterling Silver with a deep polish all over, highlighting the beauty and radiance of the metal. The case and the solid caseback each bear hallmarks from the London Assay Office, and, following a Fears tradition, our company's registered makers mark comprise the initials of the Managing Director when the watch was built (in this case: ‘NBS’ for our (4th) Managing Director, Nicholas Bowman-Scargill). The traditional and bespoke ‘onion’-shaped winding crown has fine grooves catch the light, adding a touch of radiance to the edge of the case. This crown is set with a flawless diamond (which on Fears watches signifies a case made entirely from a precious metal). DIAL Multiple layers of hand-polished pure white lacquer make up the bright white of the 'Edwardian Edition's dial. Expertly made in Germany, t he polished lacquer has a glossy appearance, quite unlike a paint or varnish that gives true depth to the colour. As this a ‘jump hour’ watch there are no hour numerals on the dial, instead the hour is displayed via a window at 12 o’clock on an hour disc also coated in a bright white lacquer. Edwardian Elegance As its name suggests this watch has been greatly inspired by the Edwardian-era pocket watches in the Fears Archive. From the crisp white and black to the elegant bespoke numerals created in-house, especially for this watch. The Fears makers mark at 12 o'clock is a recreation of the how our name appeared on dials in the early 1900s. HAND With the hours displayed neatly in a window, the Brunswick 40.5 Jump Hour 'Edwardian Edition' has a black hand-varnished minute hand which is all that is required for telling the time. The ‘Fears-shaped’ minute hand features a bevel running down its centre aiding in catching the light and making this the most legible watch we've ever made. MOVEMENT As with all Fears Jump Hours, the 'Edwardian Edition' is powered by a Swiss made, automatic winding JJ01 movement with a module developed in-house by fellow British watch company, Christopher Ward. The base of this precise movement is a Sellita SW200, with its incredible accuracy having been regulated to Chronometer grade.
